<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>dejaquetepique — surrealich / Carlota Ruiz</title>
<meta name="description" content="surrealich — sound artist, field recordist, event creator, space holder. Madrid · Berlin · East Africa.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=DM+Mono:wght@300;400&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  --deep:#1A1B5E;
  --deeper:#0D0E3A;
  --deepest:#07081F;
  --indigo:#2D2E7A;
  --teal:#1B8A8A;
  --teal-light:#4EC4C4;
  --rust:#C4612D;
  --orange:#E8722A;
  --red:#B03A2A;
  --green:#3A7A4A;
  --green-light:#6DBF82;
  --cream:#E8E4F0;
  --ghost:rgba(232,228,240,.55);
  --ghost-dim:rgba(232,228,240,.2);
  --mono:'DM Mono',monospace;
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}

/* UNDERWATER DISTORTION LAYER */
body{
  font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;
  font-weight:300;
  background:var(--deepest);
  color:var(--cream);
  overflow-x:hidden;
  cursor:crosshair;
}

/* slow caustic light ripple across whole page */
body::before{
  content:'';
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 60% at 20% 30%, rgba(30,140,140,.07) 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 100% at 80% 70%, rgba(45,46,122,.12) 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 50% 10%, rgba(196,97,45,.04) 0%, transparent 50%);
  pointer-events:none;
  z-index:0;
  animation:caustic 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
body::after{
  content:'';
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 400 400' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.035'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  pointer-events:none;
  z-index:998;
  opacity:.5;
}
@keyframes caustic{
  0%{opacity:.6;transform:scale(1) translate(0,0)}
  33%{opacity:.9;transform:scale(1.04) translate(-1%,2%)}
  66%{opacity:.7;transform:scale(.97) translate(2%,-1%)}
  100%{opacity:.8;transform:scale(1.02) translate(-2%,1%)}
}

/* NAV */
nav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;
  padding:1.2rem 2rem;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  backdrop-filter:blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
  background:rgba(7,8,31,.7);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.08);
}
.nav-logo{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:.95rem;letter-spacing:.14em;
  color:var(--teal-light);text-decoration:none;
  opacity:.7;transition:opacity .4s,letter-spacing .4s;
}
.nav-logo:hover{opacity:1;letter-spacing:.22em}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:2rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nav-links a{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.56rem;
  letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--cream);text-decoration:none;
  opacity:.3;transition:opacity .3s,color .3s;
}
.nav-links a:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--teal-light)}

/* HERO */
#hero{min-height:100vh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero-visual{
  position:relative;
  background:var(--deep);
  border-right:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-visual img{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;object-position:center;
  display:block;
  filter:saturate(1.15) contrast(1.05);
  animation:imgdrift 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes imgdrift{
  0%{transform:scale(1.02) translate(0,0)}
  50%{transform:scale(1.05) translate(-1%,1.5%)}
  100%{transform:scale(1.02) translate(1%,-1%)}
}
.hero-content{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;
  padding:4rem 3rem 3rem;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 100% 0%, rgba(27,138,138,.06) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 80% at 0% 100%, rgba(45,46,122,.15) 0%, transparent 60%);
  position:relative;z-index:1;
}
.hero-eyebrow{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;
  letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--teal-light);margin-bottom:1.5rem;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .8s ease forwards .3s;
}
.hero-name{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-weight:300;
  font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6vw,5.5rem);line-height:.9;
  color:var(--cream);margin-bottom:1.2rem;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .9s ease forwards .5s;
}
.hero-name em{font-style:italic;color:var(--teal-light);display:block}
.hero-aka{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:.15em;
  color:var(--ghost-dim);margin-bottom:2rem;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .9s ease forwards .65s;
}
.hero-roles{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;margin-bottom:2.5rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .9s ease forwards .8s}
.hero-role{
  font-size:.85rem;color:var(--ghost);
  border-left:2px solid rgba(78,196,196,.3);
  padding-left:.8rem;line-height:1.4;
}
.hero-role span{color:var(--teal-light);font-weight:400}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:1.2rem;opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .9s ease forwards 1s}
.hero-skill{
  font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;
  font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:lowercase;
  color:rgba(232,228,240,.55);
  padding:3px 0;
  transition:color .4s;
}
.hero-skill:hover{color:rgba(78,196,196,.9)}
.hero-skill-dim{color:rgba(78,196,196,.2);font-size:.5rem}
.btn{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.15em;
  text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;
  padding:.7rem 1.4rem;transition:all .4s;
}
.btn-primary{background:var(--teal);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--teal)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--teal-light);border-color:var(--teal-light);color:var(--deepest)}
.btn-ghost{border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.25);color:var(--ghost-dim)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--teal-light);color:var(--teal-light)}
.hero-bottom{
  position:absolute;bottom:1.5rem;right:1.5rem;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.18em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.2);
  writing-mode:vertical-rl;
  opacity:0;animation:fadeIn 1s ease forwards 1.5s;
}

/* SECTION BASE */
.sec{padding:6rem 2rem;position:relative}
.sec::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 50% at 50% 0%, rgba(78,196,196,.03) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.sec-light{background:var(--deep);color:var(--cream)}
.sec-dark{background:var(--deeper)}
.sec-sage{background:var(--indigo);color:var(--cream)}
.sec-deep{background:var(--deepest)}
.inner{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1}

/* SECTION HEADERS */
.sec-head{
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.8rem;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);
  padding-bottom:1rem;margin-bottom:3rem;
}
.sec-head.light{border-bottom-color:rgba(78,196,196,.15)}
.sh-n{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2.2rem;color:var(--teal-light);font-weight:300;line-height:1}
.sh-t{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:300}
.sh-s{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ghost-dim);margin-left:auto}
.sh-s.dark{color:rgba(78,196,196,.3)}

/* ABOUT */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.4fr;gap:4rem;align-items:start}
.about-photo{
  aspect-ratio:3/4;
  background:rgba(78,196,196,.05);
  border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.12);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.3);text-align:center;gap:6px;padding:1rem;
}
.about-photo span{font-size:1.6rem;opacity:.2}
.about-hl{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.4rem);
  line-height:1.15;color:var(--cream);
  margin-bottom:1.2rem;font-weight:300;
}
.about-hl em{font-style:italic;color:var(--teal-light)}
.about-p{font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ghost);margin-bottom:.9rem}
.roles-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.5rem;margin:1.5rem 0}
.role-chip{
  background:rgba(78,196,196,.06);
  color:var(--ghost);
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;
  letter-spacing:.1em;padding:.4rem .8rem;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);
}
.role-chip.accent{
  background:rgba(27,138,138,.2);
  color:var(--teal-light);
  border-color:rgba(78,196,196,.3);
}
.facts{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;
  margin-top:1.5rem;padding-top:1.5rem;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);
}
.fact-l{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);margin-bottom:2px}
.fact-v{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--ghost)}

/* STATS BAR */
.stats-bar{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--indigo) 0%, rgba(27,138,138,.4) 50%, var(--indigo) 100%);
  padding:2rem;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:0;flex-wrap:wrap;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);
}
.stat-b{flex:1;max-width:180px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.15);padding:0 1.5rem}
.stat-b:last-child{border-right:none}
.stat-n{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:3rem;color:var(--teal-light);font-weight:300;line-height:1}
.stat-l{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ghost-dim);margin-top:3px}

/* SOUND / PROJECT CARDS */
.project-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.2rem}
.proj{
  background:rgba(78,196,196,.03);
  border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.08);
  padding:1.8rem;transition:all .5s;
}
.proj:hover{
  background:rgba(78,196,196,.07);
  border-color:rgba(78,196,196,.25);
  transform:translateY(-2px);
}
.proj.featured{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:0}
.proj-left{padding:1.8rem;border-right:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.08)}
.proj-right{padding:1.8rem}
.proj-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);margin-bottom:.6rem}
.proj-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--cream);font-weight:300;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:.4rem;line-height:1.1}
.proj-period{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ghost-dim);margin-bottom:.9rem}
.proj-body{font-size:.87rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--ghost)}
.proj-quote{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.05rem;
  font-style:italic;color:rgba(78,196,196,.5);
  border-left:2px solid var(--teal);padding-left:.8rem;margin:1rem 0;
}
.proj-link{
  display:inline-block;margin-top:.9rem;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cream);text-decoration:none;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.2);padding-bottom:2px;transition:all .3s;
}
.proj-link:hover{color:var(--teal-light);border-color:var(--teal-light)}
.proj-badge{
  display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;
  letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:2px 7px;border:1px solid;margin-bottom:.8rem;
}
.badge-rust{border-color:var(--orange);color:var(--orange)}
.badge-sage{border-color:var(--teal);color:var(--teal-light)}
.proj-photo{
  background:rgba(78,196,196,.04);
  border:1px dashed rgba(78,196,196,.1);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.58rem;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.2);text-align:center;gap:6px;padding:1rem;min-height:160px;
}
.proj-photo span{font-size:1.5rem;opacity:.2}

/* SENSUOUS */
.sensuous-intro{
  background:rgba(45,46,122,.3);
  border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.12);
  padding:1.5rem;margin-bottom:2rem;
  border-left:3px solid var(--teal);
}
.sensuous-intro p{font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ghost);font-style:italic}
.events-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:.8rem}
.event-card{
  background:rgba(45,46,122,.15);
  border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);
  padding:1.2rem;transition:all .4s;
}
.event-card:hover{
  background:rgba(45,46,122,.3);
  border-color:rgba(78,196,196,.3);
  transform:translateY(-2px);
}
.ev-num{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:2rem;color:rgba(78,196,196,.3);font-weight:300;line-height:1;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.ev-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1rem;color:var(--cream);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.ev-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.6)}
.ev-body{font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ghost-dim);margin-top:.5rem}
.sensuous-vision{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(45,46,122,.6) 0%, rgba(27,138,138,.3) 100%);
  border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.15);
  padding:1.5rem;margin-top:1.5rem;grid-column:1/-1;
}
.sv-text{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-style:italic;color:rgba(232,228,240,.75);line-height:1.6;text-align:center}
.sv-sub{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.35);text-align:center;margin-top:.5rem}

/* KILIFI */
.kilifi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3rem;align-items:center}
.kilifi-hl{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.5vw,3rem);color:var(--cream);font-weight:300;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.kilifi-hl em{font-style:italic;color:var(--teal-light)}
.kilifi-p{font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ghost);margin-bottom:.9rem}
.offers-list{margin-top:1.5rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.6rem}
.offer-item{display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:flex-start}
.offer-dot{width:3px;height:3px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal-light);flex-shrink:0;margin-top:.5rem;opacity:.5}
.offer-text{font-size:.87rem;color:var(--ghost);line-height:1.6}
.kilifi-photo{
  aspect-ratio:4/5;
  background:rgba(27,138,138,.06);
  border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.6rem;
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.2);text-align:center;gap:6px;padding:1rem;
}
.kilifi-photo span{font-size:1.6rem;opacity:.2}
.kilifi-note{
  background:rgba(78,196,196,.05);
  padding:1rem;margin-top:1.5rem;
  border-left:2px solid rgba(78,196,196,.25);
}
.kilifi-note-text{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--ghost-dim);font-style:italic;line-height:1.6}

/* CONTACT */
.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4rem}
.contact-hl{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;
  font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,4rem);
  color:var(--cream);font-weight:300;line-height:1;margin-bottom:1.2rem;
}
.contact-hl em{font-style:italic;color:rgba(78,196,196,.3)}
.contact-p{font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--ghost-dim);margin-bottom:1.8rem;max-width:360px}
.contact-items{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem}
.ci{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:1rem;padding-bottom:.9rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.06)}
.ci:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.ci-l{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-light);width:75px;flex-shrink:0}
.ci-v{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--cream);text-decoration:none;transition:color .3s}
.ci-v:hover{color:var(--teal-light)}
.contact-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
.contact-quote{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.2rem;
  font-style:italic;color:rgba(78,196,196,.25);line-height:1.6;
  border-left:2px solid var(--teal);padding-left:1.2rem;margin-bottom:1.8rem;
}
.contact-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem}
.ctag{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:.08em;
  padding:3px 7px;
  border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);
  color:rgba(78,196,196,.3);
}

/* FIELD WORK */
.btl-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0}
.btl-left{padding:2rem 2rem 2rem 0}
.btl-right{padding:2rem 0 2rem 2rem;border-left:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.08)}
.btl-intro{
  background:rgba(45,46,122,.2);
  padding:1.2rem;border-left:3px solid var(--teal);margin-bottom:1.5rem;
}
.btl-intro p{font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ghost)}
.btl-item{margin-bottom:1.2rem;padding-bottom:1.2rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.06)}
.btl-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.btl-title{font-size:.92rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--teal-light);margin-bottom:2px}
.btl-body{font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.65;color:var(--ghost)}

/* VIDEO BLOCK */
.video-block{
  background:rgba(78,196,196,.03);
  border:1px dashed rgba(78,196,196,.1);
  padding:2.5rem;text-align:center;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;margin-top:1.5rem;
}
.vb-icon{font-size:2rem;color:rgba(78,196,196,.3)}
.vb-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.3)}
.vb-note{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--ghost-dim);font-style:italic}

/* FOOTER */
footer{
  background:var(--deepest);
  padding:1.2rem 2rem;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.06);
}
.foot-text{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.15)}

/* ANIMATIONS */
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s ease}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* MOBILE */
@media(max-width:768px){
  nav{padding:1rem 1.2rem}
  .nav-links{display:none}
  #hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:auto}
  .hero-visual{height:320px}
  .hero-content{padding:2.5rem 1.5rem 2rem}
  .sec{padding:4rem 1.2rem}
  .about-grid,.project-grid,.kilifi-grid,.contact-grid,.btl-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .proj.featured{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .proj-left{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.08)}
  .events-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .stats-bar{flex-wrap:wrap}
  .stat-b{max-width:50%;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1)}
  .btl-right{border-left:none;padding:0}
  footer{flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;text-align:center}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .events-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .roles-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
</style>
</head>

<!-- ABOUT -->

        <h2 class="about-hl">A morphing vessel.<br><em>Between worlds.</em></h2>
        <p class="about-p">I'm Carlota — surrealich — Spanish-born, Berlin-trained, East Africa–rooted. I create from the in-between: where pulse becomes presence and perception dissolves into vibration. Sound for me is not a technical tool — it's a vessel for connection, awareness, and regeneration.</p>
        <p class="about-p">BA Hons in Electronic Music Production and Performance, Catalyst University Berlin. Two years General Coordinator of a community school in Tanzania — 400 children, 26 staff, full operational responsibility. Co-created Sensuous, a 10-event immersive art series in Berlin. Performed at the Museum of Consciousness in Cairo. Directed Maasai Orchestra recording sessions in three languages in the Engaruka Valley.</p>
        <p class="about-p">I'm a bridge — between communities, between disciplines, between listening and action.</p>

<!-- SOUND WORK -->
<section id="sound" class="sec sec-dark">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">02</div>
      <div class="sh-t">Sound work</div>
      <div class="sh-s">Compositions · Performances · Field recordings</div>

    <!-- SENSA / MOC Cairo - FEATURED -->
    <div class="project-grid" style="margin-bottom:1.2rem">
      <div class="proj featured reveal">
        <div class="proj-left">
          <div class="proj-badge badge-rust">Live performance</div>
          <div class="proj-label">Museum of Consciousness, Cairo</div>
          <div class="proj-title">Sensa</div>
          <div class="proj-period">April 3, 2025 · Biogeometry Institute, Maadi · Cairo, Egypt</div>
          <div class="proj-quote">"To hear is to be stung, to listen is to surrender."</div>
          <p class="proj-body">A sonic performance exploring otoacoustic emissions, transformation, and deep listening. Presented alongside 6 other artists — including Scott Beibin, Ebe Oke, Sophie-Charlotte Adler, and Fadi Taiba — in an event where 7 artists attempted to alter the audience's state of consciousness through sound alone.</p>
          <p class="proj-body" style="margin-top:.6rem">Sensa combines Serengeti field recordings, layered vocals, and binaural pulses into a liminal space where sound inhabits the listener. Inspired by Samawimbi (the wave of time), Maryanne Amacher's inner ear theory, and Helmholtz's resonance.</p>
          <a href="https://linktr.ee/surrealistch" target="_blank" class="proj-link">→ Listen / linktr.ee/surrealistch</a>
        </div>
        <div class="proj-right">
          <div class="proj-photo" style="height:180px">
            <span>◻</span>Add photo from Cairo / MOC event
          </div>
          <div style="margin-top:1rem;padding:1rem;background:rgba(242,234,216,.03);border-left:2px solid rgba(196,97,45,.3)">
            <div class="proj-label">Biophony · Geophony · Anthropophony</div>
            <p style="font-size:.82rem;color:rgba(242,234,216,.5);line-height:1.6;margin-top:.4rem">Field recordings from the Serengeti colliding with the inner architecture of the human ear. The room becomes the instrument.</p>
          </div>
          <div style="margin-top:1rem">
            <div class="proj-label">Featured with</div>
            <div style="font-size:.8rem;color:rgba(242,234,216,.4);line-height:1.9;font-family:var(--mono)">
              Scott Beibin · Ebe Oke<br>
              Sophie-Charlotte Adler · Fadi Taiba<br>
              Dr. Ibrahim Karim · Sarah Janes
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- NGOTEYA + SENTINELS -->
    <div class="project-grid" style="margin-bottom:1.2rem">
      <div class="proj reveal">
        <div class="proj-badge badge-sage">Releasing 21 June 2025</div>
        <div class="proj-label">Sound score · Composition · Compositionalist</div>
        <div class="proj-title">Ngoteya Wild</div>
        <div class="proj-period">Wildlife documentary · Tanzania · 2024–2025</div>
        <p class="proj-body">Full sound score composed as surrealich. First public release under the dejaquetepique collective. Mix and mastering in collaboration with Beneath the Baobabs / Baobab Studios, Kilifi.</p>
        <p class="proj-body" style="margin-top:.6rem">Shot deep in the Tanzanian bush, this documentary required not just music but an understanding of the land itself — its textures, silences, and pulse. The score was built from field recordings made on location, transformed through Ableton into something that breathes with the ecosystem rather than over it.</p>
        <div class="proj-photo" style="height:140px;margin-top:1rem">
          <span>◻</span>Add Ngoteya Wild process photos here — you have many stories to tell about this journey
        </div>
        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.6rem;margin-top:.6rem">
          <div class="proj-photo" style="height:90px;font-size:.55rem">◻ On location in the bush</div>
          <div class="proj-photo" style="height:90px;font-size:.55rem">◻ Recording setup / field sessions</div>
          <div class="proj-photo" style="height:90px;font-size:.55rem">◻ Collaboration with Beneath the Baobabs</div>
          <div class="proj-photo" style="height:90px;font-size:.55rem">◻ Behind the score — Ableton sessions</div>
        </div>
        <a href="#" class="proj-link">→ Add link on release · 21 June 2025</a>
      </div>
      <div class="proj reveal">
        <div class="proj-badge badge-rust">In production</div>
        <div class="proj-label">Sound score · Maasai Orchestra direction</div>
        <div class="proj-title">The Sentinels of Engaruka</div>
        <div class="proj-period">Documentary · Engaruka Valley, Tanzania · 2024–2025</div>
        <p class="proj-body">33-minute sound score built from authentic field recordings — Maasai jumping sessions, traditional drought and rain songs, cattle rhythms, volcanic textures. Recording sessions directed in three languages: English, Kiswahili, and Maa.</p>
        <p class="proj-body" style="margin-top:.5rem;font-size:.8rem;opacity:.7">Zoom F8n · NTG5 · MKH 416 · Wireless Go II · contact mics · binaural pair</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SPIRAL + FIELD RECORDINGS -->
    <div class="project-grid" style="margin-bottom:1.2rem">
      <div class="proj reveal">
        <div class="proj-badge badge-rust">Audiovisual installation</div>
        <div class="proj-label">With Critical P</div>
        <div class="proj-title">SPIRAL</div>
        <div class="proj-period">2022 · Liebig12, Berlin</div>
        <div class="proj-quote">"¿Y cómo escuchará el mundo mi madre?"</div>
        <p class="proj-body">My first exhibition. SPIRAL explored perception through the simulation of a cochlear implant — born from a personal question: how does my deaf mother hear the world? Created with a multidisciplinary team including my mother Alma's voice, cochlear implant user Julia Hann von Weyhern, watercolours by my sister Nuria, and live piano by Morgan Edgerton. Presented through 4 speakers. surrealich & Critical P, direction and sound design.</p>
        <div style="margin-top:1rem;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1)">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="SPIRAL — ear watercolour, Carlota Ruiz 2022" style="width:100%;display:block;filter:saturate(1.1)" />
        </div>
        <a href="https://liebig12.net/12-05spiralsurrealichcritical-pthefatesaremockingmemo-van-zandt-jso/" target="_blank" class="proj-link">→ liebig12.net</a>
      </div>
      <div class="proj reveal">
        <div class="proj-badge badge-rust">In post-production</div>
        <div class="proj-label">Field recordings · Cultural archive</div>
        <div class="proj-title">Kisukuma community archives</div>
        <div class="proj-period">Moshi region, Tanzania · 2024–2025</div>
        <p class="proj-body">Traditional songs, ceremonies and sonic textures recorded with Kisukuma communities. To be released on Bandcamp with proceeds going directly back to the communities recorded. Monthly field reports and sonic poems in development.</p>
        <div class="video-block">
          <div class="vb-icon">▶</div>

      </div>
    </div>

      <div class="proj-title">Commissioned projects</div>

      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;margin-top:.8rem">

<!-- SENSUOUS -->
<section id="sensuous" class="sec sec-deep">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">03</div>
      <div class="sh-t">Sensuous</div>
      <div class="sh-s">Event collective · Berlin · 2022–2023</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sensuous-intro reveal">
      <p>Co-organizer, creative graphic designer, concept creator and director. Sensuous was not just an event series — it was a TAZ (Temporary Autonomous Zone): a hub for artists, sensorial explorers, and community builders. 10 events across 10 months in Berlin, housed at QS1 Studios. It dissolved when I left for Tanzania — and carries the seed of rebirth in Kilifi.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="reveal" style="margin-bottom:2rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr;gap:0;border:1px solid rgba(78,196,196,.1);overflow:hidden">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Sensuous — Collective Resonance, drawing by Carlota Ruiz" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;filter:saturate(1.05) brightness(.95)" />
      <div style="padding:2rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;background:rgba(45,46,122,.2)">
        <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(78,196,196,.5);margin-bottom:.8rem">Artwork · Carlota Ruiz</div>
        <div style="font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:1.5rem;font-style:italic;color:var(--cream);line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:.8rem">Collective Resonance</div>
        <p style="font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--ghost)">Ink and pencil drawing made during the Sensuous series. The bodies here are listening — to each other, to something between them. This is what the space felt like from the inside.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="events-grid reveal">
      <div class="event-card">
        <div class="ev-num">01</div>
        <div class="ev-title">Embodied Fluidity</div>
        <div class="ev-tag">Breath · Sound · Movement</div>
        <div class="ev-body">An elemental interplay between breath, sound and movement. Exploring how we are moved by elemental forces — from stillness to motion, from individual to collective.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="event-card">
        <div class="ev-num">02</div>
        <div class="ev-title">Aquarius Super Moon</div>
        <div class="ev-tag">Water ritual · Cacao ceremony</div>
        <div class="ev-body">Mental energy into matter. A water altar, tuning forks, singing bowls, guided meditation into embodied ritual. Exploring the different shapes of water through the body.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="event-card">
        <div class="ev-num">03</div>
        <div class="ev-title">Lions Gate</div>
        <div class="ev-tag">Rewilding · Contact improv</div>
        <div class="ev-body">The art of untamed embodiment. Sacred yes and no, EFT tapping, shaking, contact improv. A time to get loose, unleash sound, and get physical.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="event-card">
        <div class="ev-num">04</div>
        <div class="ev-title">Harvest Moon</div>
        <div class="ev-tag">surrealich × Ka · Live AV · Jason Snell</div>
        <div class="ev-body">Biosensor sound bath with Jason Snell (NYU/MIT/Sundance). Live audiovisual performance surrealich × Ka. Ground Tactics sound healings. Earth installation.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="event-card">
        <div class="ev-num">05</div>
        <div class="ev-title">Yoga Infusion</div>
        <div class="ev-tag">8 Limbs · Vedic tapestry</div>
        <div class="ev-body">Exploring the 8 Limbs of yoga and how they interplay with creatively constructing a conscious, fluid narrative attached to bodily expression.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="event-card">
        <div class="ev-num">06</div>
        <div class="ev-title">The Spell of Deep Listening</div>
        <div class="ev-tag">Pauline Oliveros · Sonic meditations</div>
        <div class="ev-body">Inspired by Pauline Oliveros. Exploring the phenomenology of hearing and the practice of deep listening. "Listening as a practice to expand consciousness across the whole space-time continuum."</div>
      </div>
      <div class="event-card">
        <div class="ev-num">07</div>
        <div class="ev-title">Equinox Vortex 777</div>
        <div class="ev-tag">Integration · Symbols · Magician</div>
        <div class="ev-body">The Magician archetype. Sigils and collective tree of life. Using symbols and tools to activate manifestation. The hermetic order, Thoth, Jodorowsky.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="event-card">
        <div class="ev-num">08</div>
        <div class="ev-title">Collective Resonance Re-union</div>
        <div class="ev-tag">Sound bath · Somatic meditation</div>
        <div class="ev-body">Deep and embodied listening. An ocean of sound where organic and metallic components fuse with the heartbeat. Movement principals within a collective moving body.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="event-card">
        <div class="ev-num">09</div>
        <div class="ev-title">Memory Palace</div>
        <div class="ev-tag">surrealich × Ka × Yogotatara · Full moon</div>
        <div class="ev-body">Live electroacoustic performance + guided meditation. The ancient Greek Loci technique meets the somatic memory palace. surrealich × Ka × Yogotatara. Ground Tactics, B777, Tothecore. 30-person intimate capacity.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="event-card">
        <div class="ev-num">10</div>
        <div class="ev-title">+ more</div>
        <div class="ev-tag">The archive is alive</div>
        <div class="ev-body">Add photos and videos from each event here. This archive is yours to complete as you continue building the world of Sensuous.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="sensuous-vision" style="grid-column:1/-1">
        <div class="sv-text">"To embrace the process of unknowns, of change, exploration of energies and flows — to enlighten the dance of synchronicity."</div>
        <div class="sv-sub">Sensuous · Berlin 2022–2023 · Reborn in Kilifi — soon</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- FIELD WORK: BORN TO LEARN -->
<section id="field" class="sec sec-light">
  <div class="inner">
    <div class="sec-head light reveal">
      <div class="sh-n">04</div>
      <div class="sh-t" style="color:var(--ink)">Field work — Born To Learn, Tanzania</div>
      <div class="sh-s dark">2024–2026</div>
    </div>
    <div class="btl-intro reveal">
      <p>Born To Learn Trust is a community school in Moshi, Tanzania — running education programs for 400+ children, Girls Preparation Courses, and sponsorship schemes for young women accessing higher education. As General Coordinator, full operational responsibility rested with me.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="btl-grid reveal">
      <div class="btl-left">
        <div class="btl-item">
          <div class="btl-title">Operations & finance</div>
          <div class="btl-body">Weekly and monthly budgets, payroll for 26 staff, supplier payments, full inventory management, donor reporting. Created the complete organizational architecture from scratch.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="btl-item">
          <div class="btl-title">Infrastructure & technical</div>
          <div class="btl-body">Daily oversight of solar energy and water systems. Construction supervision at satellite school Sumaye. Generator maintenance. When outside specialists failed, I fixed it.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="btl-item">
          <div class="btl-title">Education & creative programming</div>
          <div class="btl-body">Theatre direction. Girls Preparation Course supervision. Art and music sessions. Cultural celebrations for 200+ community members.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="btl-right">
        <div class="btl-item">
          <div class="btl-title">Volunteer coordination</div>
          <div class="btl-body">Full lifecycle management of international volunteers — onboarding, housing, timetables, conflict resolution. 26 staff across all departments.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="btl-item">
          <div class="btl-title">Kitchen & food systems</div>
          <div class="btl-body">Daily oversight of meals for 400+. Monthly bulk purchasing runs. Food cost tracking systems. Nutrition planning.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="btl-item">
          <div class="btl-title">Tourism coordination</div>
          <div class="btl-body">Organized excursions for arriving volunteers — building itineraries, contacting local sites, managing budgets and transport logistics across Tanzania.</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

I'm heading there to explore, to connect, and to feel what wants to emerge.</p>

<script>
const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');obs.unobserve(e.target)}})
},{threshold:.08,rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(r=>obs.observe(r));
</script>
